description: Upload an audio file the user attached in ChatGPT and obtain a blobUrl. Use this whenever the user attaches a recording in the conversation: pass the attachment as `file`. Then pass the returned blobUrl as the audioPath parameter to any analysis tool.

download_url.description: Download URL of the attached file, provided by ChatGPT

file_id.description: Identifier of the attached file, provided by ChatGPT
